title: Adjaruli Khachapuri
description: A boat of enriched dough filled with salty cheese, finished with an egg yolk and butter stirred through at the table while everything is still molten.
notes: You tear the pointed ends off and use them to stir the yolk into the cheese. That is the correct way to eat it and it is not optional.

steps.text: Mix the bread flour, instant yeast, sugar, and salt, then work in the warm milk and olive oil and knead until smooth.
Divide in two, roll each piece into an oval, and roll the long sides inward to make thick ropes.
steps.tip: Pinch the two ends together hard. A boat that opens in the oven loses all its cheese.

steps.text: Mix the sulguni and feta and heap it into each boat.
Bake until the crust is deep gold and the cheese is bubbling.
Pull the tray out, drop an egg yolk and some butter into each pool of cheese, and return briefly so the yolk warms without setting.
steps.tip: The yolk should still be liquid when it reaches the table.
